action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 -c "
import http.server,socketserver,threading,json
hits=[]
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(s):
        if s.path.startswith('/ip'):
            hits.append(s.client_address[0])
            b=json.dumps({'ip':s.client_address[0]}).encode()
            s.send_response(200); s.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); s.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin','*'); s.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(b))); s.end_headers(); s.wfile.write(b)
        else:
            b=open('/tmp/ts.html','rb').read()
            s.send_response(200); s.send_header('Content-Type','text/html'); s.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(b))); s.end_headers(); s.wfile.write(b)
    def log_message(s,*a): pass
http.server.HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',8899),H).serve_forever()
